common_angles: Venue directories and lists dominate (WeddingWire in 4 of 5 cities, Tripadvisor resorts, Pinterest boards in all 5)
Local Santorini planners and UK tour operators selling packages (Ionian Weddings, Olympic Holidays, Jet2, santoriniweddings.net)
One step-by-step guide by a photographer (jordanvoth.com, 10 steps) ranks in Sydney and Dubai; a Greek planner's 2026 planning guide (easywedding.gr) ranks in Sydney and Dubai
visitgreece.gr official page ranks in Melbourne, Dubai and Singapore
AI overview (AU, US) covers ceremony types, peak season, apostille and notice, and clifftop music curfews
gaps: No Australian-specific legal and documents path (CNI, apostille, Smartraveller, Embassy Athens)
No guide ties guest-list size to venue capacity and room blocks
House rules (curfew, setup, weather backup) rarely framed as written questions to ask
Guest travel (airport, ferry, access) treated thinly
Most ranking guides lead with euro prices; a price-free planning guide with a cost-drivers paragraph is a clear angle
regional_differences: AU SERPs: UK operators and venue cards; AI overview present
US: Tripadvisor forum threads (2006 to 2013) and cost pages; strongest cost intent
Dubai and Singapore: directories, YouTube cost vlog, local planner lists; AI overview asynchronous
